```{r}
library(vegan)
library(microbiomeMarker)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(readxl)
```

# Load data and create dataframes
```{r}
P.time <- readRDS('phyloseq/P.Time.RDS')
P.count <- P.time
for (n in 1:nsamples(P.count)) {
  otu_table(P.count)[,n] <- round(otu_table(P.time)[,n] * sample_data(P.time)$Reads.16S[n],0)
}

otu_table(P.count)[is.na(otu_table(P.count))] <- 0
#saveRDS(P.count, 'phyloseq/P.Time.count.RDS')
#P.count <- readRDS('phyloseq/P.Time.count.RDS')
P.sub <- subset_samples(P.count, Reads.16S >= 10000)
colnames(tax_table(P.sub)) <- c('Kingdom', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 'Genus', 'Species')
```

# Run deseq2 through microbiome marker and filter for p <0.05 and logFC >2
```{r}
out.glom <- microbiomeMarker::run_deseq2(
  P.sub, 
  group="Domestication",
  taxa_rank="Species",
  norm="RLE",
  transform="identity",
  p_adjust='fdr', 
  pvalue_cutoff=0.05,
  contrast=c('Wild','Modern'))
out<-data.frame(microbiomeMarker::marker_table(out.glom)) %>% 
  filter(., abs(ef_logFC) > 2)
```

# Get data ready to graph - sort high to low and make feature a factor
```{r}
x = tapply(out$ef_logFC, out$feature, function(x) max(x))
x = sort(x, TRUE)
out$feature = factor(as.character(out$feature), levels=names(x))
```

# Diff abund plot
```{r}
p<-ggplot(out, aes(x=feature, y=(ef_logFC), color=enrich_group)) + 
  geom_point(size=5) +
  geom_point(shape = 1,size = 5,colour = "black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -2,color='gray50')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2,color='gray50')+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('darkblue','darkorange'))+
  labs(y='Log Fold Change')+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust =0, vjust=0.5),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"), 
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.1,0.1),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p
```
